title: My text-based idle MMO is now a ChatGPT plugin, with help from Astra + Computer Use
author: IngenuityFew9216
selftext:
I've been building [idle.am](https://idle.am/), a cozy idle MMO, and it's now available as a ChatGPT plugin! You can check your character, train skills, manage quests and start your next activity right in the chat convo.

I used **GPT-6 Astra + Computer Use** to help test the integration and submit it through OpenAI's publishing portal. Under the hood, it's a TypeScript MCP server with OAuth and interactive cards, connected to our existing game.

A few tips that took me a bit to figure out:

* **Give the agent a specific test flow.** Sign in, start an activity, refresh, and check that the game actually changed. Ask for screenshots and repeat after fixes.
* **Check the UI, too.** Our tools could work while card artwork failed because of sandbox image permissions and CORS.
* **Keep game rules on the server.** The plugin follows the same rules as every other client. Purchases, trading and chat stay out of scope.

[Try the plugin](https://chatgpt.com/plugins/plugin_asdk_app_6ab021edb0348191990a7a29532b8781) (you'll need an [idle.am](https://idle.am/) account with a character).

Anyone else experimenting with a chat interface for their game?

comments.author: Le_tit_lapin_blanc
comments.body:
Clean interface, fast and efficient. Easy learning curve. 

4h of AFK time is too low for an idle game, a 20‑slot inventory is small, and the P2W perks are too prominent in the interface, i can't imagine how it will be in 3 months. Sadly like most idle games, you created problems to sell the solution without getting creative.
